entities.name: PMID:25443700
observations: Prospective Women's Health Initiative case-cohort analysis of 3,813 women followed for median 9.9 years; NT-proBNP predicted incident cardiovascular disease beyond traditional risk factors.
Adding NT-proBNP increased the C-statistic from 0.765 to 0.774, categorical NRI was 0.08, and IDI was 0.0105; authors characterized improvement as modest.

entities.name: PMID:20083731
observations: Prospective Rotterdam Study of 5,063 adults aged at least 55 years without baseline cardiovascular disease; sex-stratified analyses found strong associations between NT-proBNP and cardiovascular outcomes in women.
Adding NT-proBNP to classic risk factors improved prediction; women had net reclassification improvement of 13.3% (95% CI 5.9%-20.8%, P<0.001).

entities.name: NT-proBNP
observations: In prospective cohorts including women, baseline NT-proBNP provided incremental cardiovascular risk prediction beyond conventional risk factors, with modest discrimination gains and larger reclassification gains.
